partner_result_applied.applied_inequality: After whitening the partner tripartite core, Tbar=T/det(G)>=T>=1/256 and |det N|, sigma_min(N)>=1/512.

new_results.statement: For a normalized tripartite core with Tbar>=1/256 and a heavy row v_h of leverage L>1/2, Tbar-T_h<=1-L. Hence either 1-L>=1/512 and conditioning on the original hub leaves an exact-rank-three block with determinant and smallest singular value >=2^-18, or T_h>=1/512 and conditioning on the rest of the hub bank leaves a singleton-hub plus two-bank exact-rank-three block with the same bounds. If the resulting active frame is diffuse, the reviewed Fresnel-Brascamp-Lieb theorem gives density <=768.

An exact spectrum {1,-1,1} family has fixed-hub tripartite packet 1-epsilon and genuine rank-two internal bank geometry while max scalar pivot=1/m, max hub-pair determinant=(1-epsilon)/m and max principal-triple determinant=(1-epsilon)/m^2.

next_step: Prove a whole-bank bilinear/Fresnel bound for a uniformly conditioned exact-rank-three block consisting of one singleton hub and two disjoint original-coordinate banks with fixed-hub exterior packet >=1/512, retaining same-bank quadratic curvature and avoiding conditional-profile suprema or reciprocal single-minor selection.
